title: YEEZY QUANTUM INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum Infants ‘Amber Tint’ accentuates the shoe’s flowing lines with subtle hits of color. The basketball-inspired mid-top features a grey semi-translucent mesh upper with way synthetic overlays in a scrambled mix of tan, bronze and black. A stretchy neoprene collar delivers a snug fit, while a molded heel counter offers rearfoot stability. Responsive cushioning is provided by a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a TPU cage and supported by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Stone Sage’ dresses the slip-on silhouette in swirling beige hues. Made with injected EVA foam, the lightweight one-piece build is equipped with strategically placed vents throughout the upper, providing enhanced breathability and airflow. A sculpted heel combines with a textured footbed for a secure, comfortable fit. adidas branding is limited to the outsole, featuring a wavy traction pattern designed for multi-surface grip.

title: Denim/Ye's Personal Cargo Pant
description:
Background: Developed for Free Hoover Merch, from the "front and backs" PDF, then developed for Donda 2 Merch, from the "2.22.22 MERCH SILHOUETTES" PDF.

They were eventually updated, produced, and "released" under Yeezy Gap's 2022-2023 mainline.

This pictured pair was Ye's specifically, which he wore during October 2021.

Documented wear by Ye:
• 10/01/2021 meeting with Larry Hoover Jr
• 10/03/2021 at LAX to JFK and at The Stand in NYC with Dave Chappelle
• 10/05/2021 at a Telfar shoot in NYC, then on a commercial flight to LA
• 10/09/2021 from JFK to the Apple Store, and from there to a lunch with Anna Wintour at Sant Ambroeus in the West Village, to the Ritz Hotel to meet up with Kim Kardashian, 9 hours before her SNL Live to give her the tape; he would tell Kris Jenner his outfit was his "traveling coach vibes". He'd then meet up with Don Toliver for a bit, then head off to JFK for a flight back to LA, where he would hand out Yeezys at LAX.
